info.title: Knowledge graph L2-BPMN: BPMN Gateway API
info.description: A branch or merge. Included for connectivity rather than for a cross-model edge: a flow through a gateway with no node would point at nothing, and every reachability question over the process would break at the first decision point. Class IRI: http://smart.who.int/kg/bpmn-gateway.
